name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's journey in motorsport began in the bustling karting scene of São Paulo. As a young boy, he spent countless hours tinkering with engines and strategizing race tactics. While his driving aspirations never fully materialized, his passion for the sport led him down a different path – team management. He honed his skills in various local racing series, gradually working his way up the ranks. Ricardo joined Academy Motorsport a decade ago, initially as a race engineer, quickly proving his organizational abilities and strategic acumen, which led to his promotion to team principal. His approach is centered around fostering a collaborative environment, where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. He believes that a strong team dynamic is the key to unlocking peak performance on the track.

Ricardo is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his unwavering commitment to excellence. He's always pushing the team to innovate and improve, constantly seeking marginal gains that can make a difference on race day. He has a reputation for being calm under pressure, a quality that has served him well during countless challenging situations. Above all, Ricardo believes in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for young engineers and drivers to develop their skills. He's proud of the success stories he's helped create and is determined to continue building a winning culture at Academy Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo has a sturdy build and a focused look in his eyes, reflecting his dedication to his role.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally checking the tire pressures before every race.
